business_goal: The mandatory final integration-test task: one end-to-end round trip exercising every UC together (ingest, prefetch, playback-priority, evict, remove, signature-rotation cache hit) plus the full R11 non-regression sweep of every pre-existing public export. Declared CHOWDER on purpose: cross-cutting verification with no single business flow of its own, depending on all six other scopes' finished work (TASK-014/015/016/017/018) rather than owning a vertical slice.
